entries.title: Proverbs 29:1
segments: ¶He who is often rebuked, [and] hardens [his] neck, Will suddenly be destroyed, and that without remedy.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:2
segments: ¶When the righteous are in authority, the people rejoice; But when a wicked [man] rules, the people groan.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:3
segments: ¶Whoever loves wisdom makes his father rejoice, But a companion of harlots wastes [his] wealth.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:4
segments: ¶The king establishes the land by justice, But he who receives bribes overthrows it.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:5
segments: ¶A man who flatters his neighbor Spreads a net for his feet.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:6
segments: ¶By transgression an evil man is snared, But the righteous sings and rejoices.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:7
segments: ¶The righteous considers the cause of the poor, [But] the wicked does not understand [such] knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:8
segments: ¶Scoffers set a city aflame, But wise [men] turn away wrath.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:9
segments: ¶[If] a wise man contends with a foolish man, Whether [the fool] rages or laughs, [there is] no peace.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:10
segments: ¶The bloodthirsty hate the blameless, But the upright seek his well-being.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:11
segments: ¶A fool vents all his feelings, But a wise [man] holds them back.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:12
segments: ¶If a ruler pays attention to lies, All his servants [become] wicked.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:13
segments: ¶The poor [man] and the oppressor have this in common: The LORD gives light to the eyes of both.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:14
segments: ¶The king who judges the poor with truth, His throne will be established forever.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:15
segments: ¶The rod and rebuke give wisdom, But a child left [to himself] brings shame to his mother.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:16
segments: ¶When the wicked are multiplied, transgression increases; But the righteous will see their fall.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:17
segments: ¶Correct your son, and he will give you rest; Yes, he will give delight to your soul.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:18
segments: ¶Where [there is] no revelation, the people cast off restraint; But happy [is] he who keeps the law.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:19
segments: ¶A servant will not be corrected by mere words; For though he understands, he will not respond.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:20
segments: ¶Do you see a man hasty in his words? [There is] more hope for a fool than for him.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:21
segments: ¶He who pampers his servant from childhood Will have him as a son in the end.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:22
segments: ¶An angry man stirs up strife, And a furious man abounds in transgression.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:23
segments: ¶A man's pride will bring him low, But the humble in spirit will retain honor.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:24
segments: ¶Whoever is a partner with a thief hates his own life; He swears to tell the truth, but reveals nothing.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:25
segments: ¶The fear of man brings a snare, But whoever trusts in the LORD shall be safe.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:26
segments: ¶Many seek the ruler's favor, But justice for man [comes] from the LORD.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:27
segments: ¶An unjust man [is] an abomination to the righteous, And [he who is] upright in the way [is] an abomination to the wicked.
